//: A glob, not a hand-kept list: a module missing from the old list was only
checked when something else happened to import it, and a new module was
unchecked until someone remembered to add it.
projectm-render-worker.js is the one exclusion: it runs in a Worker scope, so
it is checked by tsconfig.worker.json against the WebWorker lib instead (the
two libs declare conflicting globals and cannot share a program).
projectm-pcm-bridge.js (the FLAC/MOD player shells' PCM producer, also used by
projectm-display-capture.js) lives at the html root, not under flac-player/,
for exactly this reason: a file outside the glob is invisible to the checker.
